cases.sentence: В земле был ___, не тот прежний голод, который был при Аврааме.
cases.translation: There was a famine in the land, not the earlier famine that occurred in the days of Abraham.
cases.explain: голод is the grammatical subject of 'был', so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Не тот прежний голод, который был при ___.
cases.translation: ...not the earlier famine that was in the days of Abraham.
cases.explain: The preposition при (in the time of) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: И Исаак пошел к Авимелеху, царю ___.
cases.translation: Isaac went to Abimelech, king of the Philistines, to Gerar.
cases.explain: The noun after 'царь' (king of) naming the ruled people takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: И Исаак пошел к ___, царю филистимлян, в Герар.
cases.translation: Isaac went to Abimelech, king of the Philistines, to Gerar.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Исаак засеял поля в той земле и в тот же год собрал ___ стократно, и Господь благословил его.
cases.translation: Isaac sowed fields in that land, and in the same year reaped a hundredfold harvest, and the Lord blessed him.
cases.explain: The transitive verb собрать (to gather/reap) takes its direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Один из мужчин мог лечь с твоей ___, и ты навлек бы на нас вину.
cases.translation: One of the men might have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: У него были такие большие стада мелкого и крупного ___.
cases.translation: He had such great flocks of small and large livestock.
cases.explain: скот here is a genitive of composition — 'herds of livestock' — so the genitive is needed.

cases.sentence: Авимелех сказал ___, «Уходи от нас, ты стал слишком силен для нас».
cases.translation: Abimelech said to Isaac, 'Go away from us, you have become too strong for us.'
cases.explain: The verb сказать (to say to someone) takes its indirect object in the dative case.

reading.ru: И Исаак пошел к Авимелеху, царю филистимлян, в Герар.
reading.question: Where did Isaac go during the famine?
options: To Gerar, to Abimelech king of the Philistines
reading.correct: To Gerar, to Abimelech king of the Philistines
reading.explain: The text says Isaac went 'к Авимелеху, царю филистимлян, в Герар' (to Abimelech, king of the Philistines, to Gerar).

reading.ru: «Это моя сестра», потому что боялся сказать, «Это моя жена».
reading.question: What did Isaac say about Rebekah, out of fear?
reading.explain: Isaac said 'Это моя сестра' (She is my sister) because he was afraid to admit she was his wife.

reading.ru: А Вимилех приказал всему народу, «Всякий, кто тронет этого человека или его жену, непременно будет предан смерти».
reading.question: What did Abimelech command the people after learning the truth?
options: That anyone who touched Isaac or Rebekah would be put to death
That Isaac must leave Gerar immediately
That Isaac must pay a fine
That Rebekah must return to her family
reading.correct: That anyone who touched Isaac or Rebekah would be put to death
reading.explain: Abimelech commanded that anyone who touched Isaac or his wife 'непременно будет предан смерти' (would surely be put to death).

reading.ru: Исаак засеял поля в той земле и в тот же год собрал урожай стократно, и Господь благословил его.
reading.question: How much did Isaac's harvest yield the year he sowed in Gerar?
reading.explain: The text says he reaped a harvest 'стократно' (a hundredfold).

reading.ru: Они засыпали землей все колодцы, которые еще во времена его отца выкопали слуги отца его Авраам.
reading.question: What did the Philistines do to Abraham's old wells?
reading.explain: The text says the Philistines 'засыпали землей' (filled with earth) the wells dug in Abraham's time.

reading.ru: Он назвал колодец Есек, потому что они спорили с ним.
reading.question: Why did Isaac name a well 'Esek'?
options: Because the herdsmen quarreled over it
reading.correct: Because the herdsmen quarreled over it
reading.explain: The text says the well was named Esek 'потому что они спорили с ним' (because they quarreled over it).

reading.ru: Он ушел оттуда и выкопал еще один колодец, из-за которого ссоры не было, и он назвал его Риховод
reading.question: What did Isaac name the well over which there was no quarrel?
reading.explain: The text says he named the well without quarrel 'Риховод' (Rehoboth).

reading.ru: Авимелех пришел к нему из Герара вместе с Ахузатом, своим личным советником, и Фихолом, начальником его войска.
reading.question: Who accompanied Abimelech when he came to see Isaac?
options: Ahuzzath his adviser and Phicol the army commander
reading.correct: Ahuzzath his adviser and Phicol the army commander
reading.explain: The text names 'Ахузатом, своим личным советником, и Фихолом, начальником его войска' (Ahuzzath his adviser and Phicol his army commander) as those with Abimelech.

reading.ru: Когда Исаву было сорок лет, он женился на Иегудифе, дочери Хетта Беэра, и на Босимате, дочери Хетта Илона, и от них было много огорчения Исааку и Ревеке.
reading.question: What did Esau's Hittite wives cause for Isaac and Rebekah?
reading.explain: The text says his wives brought 'много огорчения Исааку и Ревеке' (much grief to Isaac and Rebekah).
